official_definition: Creator Unleash: 1 [LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step) By putting one core from an "Alex"-named Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, during this turn, every "Avatar" family Spirit/Ultimate you control is treated as being on its highest level.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Creator Unleash] or [Creator Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Creator Unleash]", "give [Creator Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
